title: Agent release metadata prepare command
summary: Adds myapes:changelog-prepare so agents scaffold and sync VERSION, releases.json, module-runtime-contract.json, and version-pinned tests in the same PR before merge and Cloudron deploy.
changes: Added myapes:changelog-prepare with stub-then-fill release scaffolding, dry-run support, and guards against incomplete or repeated bumps.
Extended release validation to require module-runtime-contract.json application_version sync and reject scaffold TODO: placeholders.
Documented mandatory end-of-work release steps in AGENTS.md, a Cursor rule, and a release-metadata skill.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release adding agent-facing release preparation tooling without changing runtime application behavior.
validation: PrepareChangeLog and ReleaseHistory phpunit suites, myapes:changelog-validate, and myapes:changelog-prepare dry-run against the repository.
known_limitations: Agents must still replace scaffold TODO: narrative fields before validation passes; the prepare command does not author public release prose.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, the prepare command and preparer service, validator extensions, agent docs, and version-pinned test updates. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the agent release metadata prepare command work for MyAPES Account issue #67.
